answer: Locks are recorded in island, expire in voyage, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 185 aliases therefore needs 98 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1872 identities would post 3181 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
